_what: Token prices, USD per million tokens, per model and per token kind.
_refresh: tools/fetch-pricing.sh — re-reads the page above and rewrites this file. Prices change; a number typed into a script does not.
_note: verified:false means these are the shipped seed, not a fetch. They are transcribed from the source URL on the seeded date and are used as a fallback so cost is never zero — but run fetch-pricing.sh before trusting a cost figure, and re-run it whenever a model ships. analyze-metrics.sh prints this file's age.
_partners: Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are partner-priced and are NOT on the page above. If your team runs there, replace these values with the partner rates and set _verified manually.

_fallback_multipliers._use: Applied to a model's input price only when that model has no explicit per-kind entry above — a model released after the last fetch, for instance.
